name: u8xm
title: The community's U8 word with exit frames and mutable sources (five centre-source copies kept)
statement: OpenAI's UniformFourier statement (DFT of every length and convolution), only the exponent and seven names changed

compared_with.what: Lean-checked record before these packages (Jeremy Kothe's #588 circuit in Ryan Shea's Lean tree)

tree_change: the tree's lakefile.lean needs one more library line for the five XExit modules: lean_lib XExit where globs := #[`XExit.+] (logs/colab-xexit/lakefile-tail.txt); apply-overlay.sh does not add it
machine: Google Colab VM: Linux x86-64, Intel Xeon 2.20 GHz, 8 logical processors, 51 GiB, kernel 6.6.122+ without Landlock, no systemd

certificate.note: 126 helpers end at exit frames of dimension 4 or 8; Shea's 112 source copies folded back except the 5 of the sources that host a split centre (9, 11, 57, 81, 92)

new_lean.Work/KMX: exit frames over the mutable-source scalar half: HalvesZ, ExitEndZ (with the new condition ExitColsX), ZCheckZ, LabelsXZ, GlueXZ
new_lean.Work/KLow: exit frames on the U8 word (the same files as community/u8x)
new_lean.Work/XMut: mutable sources (the same files as community/c588m)

checks.what: one Lake build of the five targets in a copy of the U8X tree on the first Colab machine, one Lean thread: 9,305 jobs, 22 minutes, 8.9 GB, rc 0; then lake build --no-build is up to date
the five XExit modules (exit frames) were compiled earlier in the same Colab tree by a separate build, from the same sources (logs/colab-xexit/xx-hashes.txt); the Lake runs below replayed them
